title: Flagged for Review — irregularities and unverified items (none block publication)

rows.title: No official market price source exists
rows.detail: Every market open/close, market line and difference cell in this project is blank because the NFL publishes no betting lines. Blanks are policy, not omissions.

rows.title: All staking numbers use an ASSUMED -110 price
rows.detail: Straight-up side picks are not obtainable at -110 in real markets (favorites carry heavier juice). Staking ROI figures are mechanical applications of the declared assumption and must not be read as achievable returns. Points are held at 0 by amendment A1 until prices are verified.

rows.title: 105 of 137 feed rows are aggregate-verified only
rows.detail: Weeks 2-8 games were not re-read page-by-page this session; their correctness rests on 160/160 aggregate matches plus a 32-game line-by-line sample. Proposed full re-read: SG-02.

rows.title: Dates for weeks 2-8 are peer-transcribed
rows.detail: CR-04 (rest) uses feed dates; only weeks 1, 9, 10 dates were re-read this session.

rows.title: Player-prop strategy S5 permanently blocked
rows.detail: No official player-prop prices exist; S5 cannot be validated, settled or scored. Blank cells everywhere props would appear.

rows.title: Week 10 injury capture now covers all 8 of 8 official chunks (resolved 2026-11-16)
rows.detail: All 8 chunks of nfl.com/injuries/ (Week 10, 2026) were transcribed line by line: 347 player rows across 14 game sections and 28 clubs, every row with fetch clock and chunk attribution, blank cells preserved; closes the prior 2-of-8 gap. Raw transcript pinned with sha256 in injuries_week10_capture.json. Remaining gap: one report date only, no daily archive (CR-09). CAVEAT (FB-18): the official page mislabels players under wrong team headers, so team assignments are transcribed exactly as published and are not corrected or inferred.

rows.title: No official depth chart
rows.detail: nfl.com depth-chart routes do not resolve; 2nd/3rd/4th-string depth is published only where official prose states it (RD-01). All other depth cells blank.

rows.title: Week 10 scores page hides some finals
rows.detail: The WAS-NYG final rendered as 'Hidden Score' on the scores page; the score was read from the official game page instead (24-21).

rows.title: Open and close snapshots taken in the same session
rows.detail: Open = model trained through Week 9; close = trained through Week 10 TNF (one extra game). Drift is small (e.g., IND@HOU side -8.0 -> -7.9). A true pre-kickoff close requires a re-run before 2026-11-19 (SG-11).

rows.title: Gate thresholds are project policy, not official rules
rows.detail: G1-G8 and D1 thresholds (n>=100, CI rules, placebo p<0.05) are design choices declared in gates.json.

rows.title: Model has no quarterback, injury or depth features
rows.detail: Origination uses only official score-derived ratings; confirmed QB changes (e.g., MIA, SEA) cannot move the line (Q06/Q07).

rows.title: Fitted HFA (+0.15 pts) is far below the historical norm
rows.detail: 137-game sample; could be genuine for 2026 so far or estimation noise (Q11).

rows.title: S2 total model underperforms the constant-mean baseline
rows.detail: Total MAE 21.6 (model) vs 11.1 (train mean) in walk-forward — early-week small samples and noisy off/def sums. Published as-is; S2 fails its gates.

rows.title: Post-hoc baseline comparison not pre-registered
rows.detail: Model 0.673 vs better-record 0.635 is a post-hoc diagnostic (amendment A2); the pre-registered G2 baseline remains 0.500.

rows.title: Parallel session PR #93 touches shared files
rows.detail: Open PR #93 (nfl-command-center) also edits COORDINATION.md and index.html; conflicts will be resolved union-style at integration, no work discarded.

rows.title: Placebo p reported as 0/500 draws
rows.detail: S1's placebo p is '<0.002' (0 of 500 placebos reached its ROI), displayed as such rather than as an exact zero probability.

rows.title: CR-04 p-values use a normal approximation of the t test
rows.detail: Disclosed in correlations.json method; exact t-distribution p-values are not computed (stdlib only).

rows.title: Official injury page team labels are inconsistent
rows.detail: nfl.com/injuries/ prints several players under the wrong club header (e.g., J.J. McCarthy under NYG, Micah Parsons and Zaire Franklin under GB, Mike Evans under SF, Kyler Murray under MIN, Myles Garrett under LAR). Rows in injuries_week10_capture.json are transcribed exactly as published under the team header shown; no team assignment is corrected or inferred, so no depth/injury deficiency may be derived from team labels alone.

rows.title: CORRECTION to FB-18: its J.J. McCarthy example is refuted
rows.detail: FB-18 said McCarthy is printed under the wrong club (NYG). The official nfl.com player page lists him as a New York Giants player, and an nfl.com news item says the Giants 'shipped a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for J.J. McCarthy earlier this season'. The NYG header is therefore correct for this player. FB-18 is kept unedited for the record; its other examples (Parsons, Franklin, Evans, Murray, Garrett) were not re-tested on 2026-11-18. Checked in data/verification_2026-11-18.json V18-06.

rows.title: Week 11 official injury report not yet published (PENDING)
rows.detail: On 2026-11-18 the official Week 11 injury URL returned the Week 10 report body. No Week 11 designation is recorded in this project; the Week 11 availability fields stay blank until the official report is live and captured with a timestamp. Checked in data/verification_2026-11-18.json V18-05.

rows.title: Week 10 injury row count not re-derived from the live page; brief's 279/254 not reproduced
rows.detail: The committed Week 10 transcript holds 347 data rows (internally consistent, sha256 matches the capture). The live page prints no row total and cannot be fetched from bash, so 347 was not recounted against the live page on 2026-11-18. The 279 rows (and 254 rows) cited in the brief are not reproduced by any committed transcript. Treat 347 as internally consistent only until a machine-readable copy of the report is captured. Checked in data/verification_2026-11-18.json V18-04.

rows.title: Five NFL pull requests still open and stale (last updates 13-17 Nov)
rows.detail: Open PRs found on 2026-11-18: #150 (R09 prospective-only leaderboards, updated 2026-11-17), #132 (NFL Command Center, last update 2026-11-16, with failing checks recorded on the coordination board), #127 (nfl-reconciled, 2026-11-16), #119 (nfl-verify, 2026-11-15), #93 (NFL Command Center, 2026-11-13). Their branches are owned by other sessions; none is merged or closed by this session. Owner decision needed: merge, rebase or close.

rows.title: Week 11 Sunday Night header shows a 'Mexico City 2026' logo; venue not verified
rows.detail: The official Week 11 schedule page prints a Mexico City 2026 logo above the Sunday Night Football block. The game listed in that block is Vikings at 49ers (8:20 PM ET, NBC) and the page prints no Mexico City venue for it. The venue of every fixture still needs transcription from the official game centre; no venue is inferred here.

rows.title: 48 definitional table rows carry no source link (exempt by design)
rows.detail: nfl-book/engine/verify.py exempts tables marked class="meta" (column meanings, order audit, navigation, and the index's section list) from the every-row-has-a-source rule. These 48 rows hold schema or navigation text, not factual values, but under the brief's strict rule they are unsourced. They should link to the engine file that defines them. Not changed this session; the count is recomputed in every verify run.
